obligation_summary: Board-approved Customer Acceptance Policy reviewed annually
No anonymous or fictitious accounts
Categorise customers as Low/Medium/High risk
Review risk categorisation at least every 6 months
Verify identity and address with OVD before account opening
Identify beneficial owners holding more than 10%
Obtain physical self-attested OVD copy within 30 days of e-KYC (DELETED in v2)
applicability: Applicable in v1; removed in v2

obligation_summary: V-CIP sessions need liveness check, India geo-location, and specifically trained official
design_assessment: Inadequate (no liveness, no geo-location, generic vendor training)

obligation_summary: V-CIP recordings stored in India and preserved per Section 9
Periodic KYC update every 2/8/10 years (High/Medium/Low)
design_assessment: Inadequate (3 years for High risk vs 2)

obligation_summary: Monitor transactions on an ongoing basis
Dispose of monitoring alerts within 30 days
File CTR by the 7th of the following month
File STR within 7 working days of suspicion conclusion
Retain transaction and identity records at least 5 years after closure
Appoint Principal Officer and Designated Director; inform FIU within 15 days
Annual KYC/AML staff training with attendance records
Apply stricter home/host rules to overseas branches
Collect only necessary customer personal data
Do not retain customer personal data more than 3 years after closure
Encrypt customer data at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.2+)
Review privileged access at least quarterly
Report cyber incidents to CBA within 6 hours
MFA for all remote access and all privileged access
design_assessment: Inadequate (privileged on-prem access has no MFA)

obligation_summary: Board-approved Information Security Policy reviewed annually
Retain security logs at least 180 days
Third-party data stored only in India and vendor audited annually
